verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a payments platform, but the evidence never documents a batch or bulk endpoint, nor any UI feature that acts on many items at once. What it does show are single-item API operations: create, update, remove and list payments. These are only developer building blocks a user could loop over. Installments via totalValue split one payment, and automatic notifications are an adjacent feature, so neither counts as bulk operations across many items.
